featuring: @yungymc @JadenMAN @Dione4K eggchan

snippet.title: GTA 6 Gameplay LEAKED Before the Netflix Trailer Reveal!
snippet.description:
Copy of GTA 6 Game LEAKED Before the Netflix Trailer Reveal! GTA 6 Gameplay Just LEAKED Before Netflix GTA 6 Extended Reveal and GTA 6 Gameplay Trailer 3!

GTA 6 gameplay footage was just LEAKED before the GTA 6 Netflix Extended Look and GTA 6 Gameplay Trailer 3. A new piece of alleged Grand Theft Auto 6 gameplay footage has been LEAKED showing GTA 6 gameplay. It appears to be an unfinished build of Rockstar's highly anticipated open-world GTA 6 game. 

Unlike many fake GTA 6 leaks and fan-made videos that have appeared online, this footage is being closely examined by members of the GTA 6 community who believe the footage could be legitimate. The BIG question: is the GTA 6 leak REAL?

#GTA6Leaks #GTA6News #GTA6Netflix #GTA6Gameplay

GTA 6 Gameplay Just LEAKED Before Netflix Reveal! In this video, we take a look at:
- The GTA 6 Gameplay Footage Just Leaked Before the Netflix Extended Look Reveal
- What the GTA 6 Gameplay Leak Actually Shows
- Why GTA 6 Fans Think the GTA 6 Leaked Footage Is Real
- GTA 6 Leaked Gameplay Footage Has Been Revealed
- Rockstar Issues GTA 6 DMCA Takedown Notices for GTA 6 Leaked Gameplay
- What the New GTA 6 Gameplay Leak Means

The leaked gameplay appears to show an unreleased GTA 6 build running in-game, including gameplay systems, character animations, environmental details and interactions that haven't been publicly demonstrated by Rockstar.

But things get even more interesting. Reports circulating online claim that Rockstar Games / Take-Two Interactive have been issuing DMCA takedowns against copies of the footage, causing the leak to rapidly disappear from social media and other platforms.

So is this actually real GTA 6 gameplay?

In this video, we break down:
- The newly leaked GTA 6 gameplay footage
- What the GTA leaked gameplay actually shows
- Why GTA 6 fans believe the footage could be legitimate
- The details that make the leak difficult to dismiss
- The reaction from GTA 6 analysts and members of the community
- Reports of Rockstar/Take-Two DMCA takedowns
- How this compares to the massive GTA 6 leak from 2022
- What the leak could reveal about GTA 6's gameplay systems
- What this could mean ahead of the upcoming GTA 6 reveal
- And the big question: what other GTA 6 footage could still be out there?

Rockstar has not officially confirmed the authenticity of this specific footage, so everything surrounding the current leak should be treated as unconfirmed unless Rockstar or Take-Two publicly verifies it.

With Grand Theft Auto VI being one of the most anticipated video games in history, even a few seconds of genuine gameplay can reveal more about Rockstar's next open-world than an entire trailer.

Rockstar clearly doesn't want this footage online.

snippet.description:
#Lanterns #HBOMAX 

🎥 Attention viewers! (ITS FAN MADE)
Lanterns is bringing the DCU to HBO Max, and this breakdown covers everything from the newest trailer to the latest episode promos fans have been dissecting. Aaron Pierre stars as John Stewart alongside Kyle Chandler as Hal Jordan, bringing a grounded, detective-noir take on the Green Lantern mythology that's already setting this HBO original series apart from typical superhero fare. This video dives into the Lanterns Season 1 Episode 2 and Episode 3 promo footage, breaking down key reveals, character dynamics, and what James Gunn's DCU has planned for this corner of the universe. Whether you're tracking the newest HBO Max teaser, searching for the latest Lanterns trailer content, or just want the full breakdown on Aaron Pierre and Kyle Chandler's performances, this video has everything you need on DC's next big small-screen adaptation, streaming exclusively on HBO Max.

The inspiration behind this video:
Lanterns Season 1 Episode 2 Promo has just dropped on HBO Max and Aaron Pierre and Kyle Chandler are already delivering two of the most compelling and emotionally rich performances in the entire history of DCU television as John Stewart and Hal Jordan find themselves pulled deeper into a mystery so dark and so cosmically terrifying that neither Green Lantern has ever faced anything remotely like it before! This Lanterns New Trailer from HBO Max confirms that Lanterns HBO is operating at a level of prestige storytelling that only an HBO Original Series backed by the full creative weight of James Gunn's DCU vision could possibly achieve — with every single frame of this Lanterns Trailer proving that HBOMax has delivered the Green Lantern adaptation that DC fans have been demanding for decades. The Lanterns HBO Max production quality, the grounded noir detective tone, and the electric chemistry between Aaron Pierre Lanterns and Kyle Chandler make this HBO Trailer the most exciting DCU television promo since the entire new universe was first announced!

As the story accelerates toward the Lanterns Season 1 Episode 3 Promo, this Lanterns Final Trailer energy surrounding Hal Jordan and John Stewart's investigation is building a mythology so rich and so deeply rooted in Green Lantern lore that every HBO Max Series fan and every DCU faithful is completely locked in for the long haul of this landmark Max series. This HBO Max Trailer reveals Aaron Pierre and Kyle Chandler pushing their Green Lantern partnership into territory that is equal parts emotionally devastating and cosmically thrilling — delivering the kind of HBO Originals character work that transforms a superhero show into genuine prestige drama that transcends the genre entirely. With HBO Max Teaser after HBO Max Teaser raising the creative bar higher with every single episode, Lanterns HBO Max is cementing itself as the crown jewel of the entire DCU television slate and the most important HBO Original Series that HBOMax has launched in years!

Subscribe and smash the notification bell right now so you never miss a single Lanterns episode promo, HBO Max Trailer drop, or DCU exclusive breakdown as Aaron Pierre and Kyle Chandler continue to redefine what Green Lantern storytelling can achieve on the HBO Max YouTube platform! Now these enemies are constantly growing stronger so as the player we need to run around the map collecting rogue like upgrades to build an overpowered or synergistic main hero to destroy the opposition. HOWEVER As you can probably see from the steam reviews a lot of people struggle with the difficulty of this game and at higher levels it can feel like an Impossible moba.

snippet.title: SAM TOMPKINS - HOW TO SAVE A LIFE (THE FRAY COVER)
snippet.description:
Listen to HOW TO SAVE A LIFE (my version): https://SamTompkins.lnk.to/HTSALID

My sophomore album "ARE WE GONNA SING?" is out September 4th 2026. Pre-order now from https://SamTompkins.lnk.to/AreWeGonnaSingID

3 and a half years ago, i was in my living room and i decided to record a cover of one of my favourite songs of all time. i pressed record and as soon as i got the take i new it was special. we posted a vid that night and i went to watch the football… a couple hours later i checked my phone. it was blowing up.

i kept refreshing my page over and over again and it just kept going up. it felt so good. so many people saying the cover took them back to their youth listening to the original like i used to, some were saying it felt like a brand new song to them and to a few it was genuinely a song they hadn’t heard before (this made me feel old).

the following year i posted it again and it blew up even more, but my life was kinda in a strange place. the band who originally wrote the song even commented on one of the videos saying I’d killed it. (I was hoping this was in a good way)

I took a break from releasing music a little while after this cos i lost my dad. my house got robbed also and my old laptop i recorded this on was stolen. 

i came back at the start of this year with some new music. i announced a tour and stuff and was just getting settled back into the swing of things and a few weeks ago on a bit of a random one, i decided to post the cover again. this time it totally went insane. turned out so many of you had been patiently waiting for literal years for me to post it. the fray started interacting with my videos. they told me they preferred my version and then even pushed me to release it.

anyway last week i got in the studio, brought my $200 mic i recorded the original version on and made it happen. i thought I’d lost the original files when my laptop got stolen but found them on a hard drive. 

it’s kinda crazy… some of the vocals here are the same from 2023, before my dad passed, before a lot of stuff happened, and the rest is now where things are so different, but for some reason it feels special. 

i think this song itself has meant so much to me throughout my life and even when recording the original cover, it means something very different to now. that’s what makes music so special. a different voice, melody, a different mindset, any slight change can breath new life into something like this.

anyway, thank you so much for waiting and i’m so grateful. love you guys.

how to save a life (my version) is out now on everything! love you so much !

special thanks to the fray for being so cool throughout this process and even more importantly thanks to you guys for being so supportive as always. 

and on that note, if you wanna be extra awesome and nice and cool, please if you have a chance pre order my album from my store below or grab a ticket to the tour. it would mean infinite amounts to me.

snippet.title: This 1975 Performance Defined Fleetwood Mac's Future
snippet.description:
Fleetwood Mac in 1975 | Rhiannon

🔔 Subscribe to Rock Through Time channel: https://bit.ly/3Oc7bqB

Fleetwood Mac performs their iconic hit Rhiannon during this pivotal 1975 concert appearance. This performance captures the band shortly after Stevie Nicks and Lindsey Buckingham joined the lineup, marking the beginning of their most commercially successful era. The track serves as a centerpiece of their self-titled album, which eventually reached number one on the Billboard 200 chart. Fans of classic rock will appreciate this rare glimpse into the chemistry that defined the group's sound for decades to come.

The Lineup:

🎤 Stevie Nicks (Lead Vocals)
🎸 Lindsey Buckingham (Guitar, Vocals)
🎹 Christine McVie (Keyboards, Vocals)
🎸 John McVie (Bass Guitar)
🥁 Mick Fleetwood (Drums)

3 Fast Facts About The Video

- Stevie Nicks wrote this song after reading a novel about a Welsh witch named Rhiannon, mistakenly believing the character was a goddess.
- This specific era of the band marked the transition from their previous blues-oriented style to the polished pop-rock sound that dominated the late 1970s.
- The song became a staple of the band's live shows, often featuring extended, improvised guitar solos by Lindsey Buckingham that evolved significantly over the years.

Fleetwood Mac performs their iconic hit Rhiannon during this pivotal 1975 concert appearance. This performance captures the band shortly after Stevie Nicks and Lindsey Buckingham joined the lineup, marking the beginning of their most commercially successful era. The track serves as a centerpiece of their self-titled album, which eventually reached number one on the Billboard 200 chart. Fans of classic rock will appreciate this rare glimpse into the chemistry that defined the group's sound for decades to come.

🎸 Lindsey Buckingham (Guitar, Vocals)
🎹 Christine McVie (Keyboards, Vocals)
🎸 John McVie (Bass Guitar)
🥁 Mick Fleetwood (Drums)

3 Fast Facts About The Video

- Stevie Nicks wrote this song after reading a novel about a Welsh witch named Rhiannon, mistakenly believing the character was a goddess.
- This specific era of the band marked the transition from their previous blues-oriented style to the polished pop-rock sound that dominated the late 1970s.
- The song became a staple of the band's live shows, often featuring extended, improvised guitar solos by Lindsey Buckingham that evolved significantly over the years.

snippet.title: The GTA 6 Leaks, Explained by a 14-Year Game Dev (Not What You Think)
snippet.description:
Everyone's asking about the GTA 6 leaks… is the Cyberleek footage real, is there really a second breach out of Rockstar India, and can Rockstar just release the game early since it's clearly playable? 

I spent 14 years managing game productions, including time at Epic. Here's what actually happened, told honestly, without showing a single frame of leaked footage.

00:00 - What everyone's actually asking
00:55 - My background (quick reminder)
01:30 - What a "playable build" actually is
05:07 - How a build like this actually gets out
08:00 - What we know about the Cyberleek leak (claim by claim)
11:40 - A second leak, and a myth about it
14:29 - Why this can't move the release date
17:06 - Why I'm covering it this way
18:38 - What I want to know from you

📊 Sources referenced in this video:

Hands over mouth: Photo by Sedk Mahmoud on Unsplash

What is ROBLOX? ROBLOX is an online virtual playground and workshop, where people of all ages can safely interact, create, have fun, and learn. It’s unique in that practically everything on ROBLOX is designed and constructed by members of the community. ROBLOX is designed for 8 to 18 year olds, but it is open to people of all ages. Each player is also given their own piece of undeveloped real estate along with a virtual toolbox with which to design and build anything — be it a navigable skyscraper, a working helicopter, a giant pinball machine, a multiplayer “Capture the Flag” game or some other, yet­to­be­dreamed-up creation. There is no cost for this first plot of virtual land. By participating and by building cool stuff, ROBLOX members can earn specialty badges as well as ROBLOX dollars (“ROBUX”). In turn, they can shop the online catalog to purchase avatar clothing and accessories as well as premium building materials, interactive components, and working mechanisms.

snippet.title: The Most Misunderstood Character Trope
snippet.description:
Click this link https://boot.dev/?promo=DARYLTALKSGAMES and use my code DARYLTALKSGAMES to get 25% off your first payment for boot.dev!

This video has been brewing in the back of my mind for awhile now and after finishing Lies of P and Final Fantasy IX around the same time, I am finally ready to talk about it. The artificial human character trope is such a fascinating topic in fiction to me. But I do think that in some stories, there is a critical component to them that we miss. Because it’s not *just* about exploring what it is that makes us human, it’s also about watching them be better than their creators. It’s about acceptance, validity, and finding a place to call home.
